f.title: Notify bans, restrictions and new benefit-risk information immediately
f.statement: The MAH or registration holder shall immediately communicate to the minister or his delegate any prohibition or restriction imposed by the competent authority of any country in which the medicinal product is marketed, and any other new information that might influence the evaluation of the benefits and risks of the medicinal product. This information includes both positive and negative results of clinical trials or other studies in all indications and populations, whether or not included in the marketing authorisation, as well as data on use of the medicinal product outside the terms of the marketing authorisation.

rows.actor: Holder of a marketing authorisation (AMM) or registration
rows.quote: Le titulaire de l'[3 AMM]3 ou de l'enregistrement communique immédiatement au ministre ou à son délégué toute Page 10 de 47 Copyright Moniteur belge 18-06-2026 interdiction ou restriction imposée par l'autorité compétente de tout pays dans lequel le médicament est mis sur le marché et toute autre information nouvelle qui pourrait influencer l'évaluation des bénéfices et des risques du médicament concerné. [1 [20 Les]20 informations en question comprennent les résultats tant positifs que négatifs des essais cliniques ou d'autres études pour toutes les indications et populations, qu'elles figurent ou non dans l'AMM ou l'enregistrement, ainsi que des données concernant toute utilisation du médicament d'une manière non conforme aux termes de l'AMM ou de l'enregistrement.]1
data_elements: prohibition or restriction by a foreign authority
positive and negative clinical trial results

The information in question includes both positive and negative results of clinical trials or other studies in all indications and populations, whether or not included in the MA or registration, as well as data on any use of the medicinal product outside the terms of the MA or registration.

f.title: Keep product information up to date with current scientific knowledge
f.statement: The MAH or registration holder shall ensure that the product information is kept up to date with current scientific knowledge, including the conclusions of assessments and recommendations made public on the European medicines web-portal where applicable.

rows.actor: Holder of a marketing authorisation (AMM) or registration
rows.quote: titulaire de l'AMM ou de l'enregistrement veille à ce que les informations sur le médicament soient mises à jour d'après les connaissances scientifiques actuelles, y compris les conclusions des évaluations et les recommandations rendues publiques par l'intermédiaire du portail web européen le cas échéant.

rows.quote_en: ...holder of the MA or registration shall ensure that the information on the medicinal product is updated in line with current scientific knowledge, including the conclusions of assessments and the recommendations made public via the European web-portal where applicable.

f.title: Respond fully and promptly to requests for benefit-risk data
f.statement: So that the benefit-risk balance can be evaluated continuously, the minister or his delegate may at any time ask the MAH or registration holder to transmit data demonstrating that the benefit-risk balance remains favourable; the holder shall reply fully and promptly to such requests.

rows.actor: Holder of a marketing authorisation (AMM) or registration
rows.quote: le rapport bénéfice/risque puisse être évalué [1 en continu]1, le ministre ou son délégué peut à tout moment demander au titulaire de l'[3 AMM]3 ou de l'enregistrement de transmettre des données démontrant que le rapport bénéfice/risque demeure favorable. [1 Le titulaire de l'AMM ou de l'enregistrement apporte une réponse complète et rapide à de telles demandes.]1

The holder of the MA or registration shall provide a complete and rapid reply to such requests.

f.title: Submit an updated PSMF copy within 7 days of a request
f.statement: The minister or his delegate may at any time ask the MAH or registration holder to produce an updated copy of its pharmacovigilance system master file (dossier permanent du système de pharmacovigilance); the holder shall submit that copy within a maximum of seven days after receipt of the request.

f.title: Provide sales and prescription volume data on request
f.statement: At the request of the minister or his delegate, in particular in the context of pharmacovigilance, the MAH or registration holder shall communicate all information on the volume of sales and any information it holds on the volume of prescriptions.

rows.actor: Holder of a marketing authorisation (AMM) or registration
rows.quote: A la demande du ministre ou de son délégué, en particulier dans le cadre de la pharmacovigilance, le titulaire de l'[3 AMM]3 ou de l'enregistrement d'un médicament lui communique toutes les informations relatives au volume des ventes effectuées et toute information qu'il détient en relation avec le volume des prescriptions.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and scope; statement adds nothing. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force; level follows the legislative present indicative, which states a binding duty in Belgian law (Mandatory).
rows.quote_en: At the request of the minister or his delegate, in particular in the context of pharmacovigilance, the holder of the MA or registration of a medicinal product shall communicate to him all information relating to the volume of sales made and any information it holds relating to the volume of prescriptions.

f.title: Include exceptional-circumstances MA conditions in the risk management system
f.statement: Where a marketing authorisation is granted in exceptional circumstances subject to conditions (in particular on the safety of the medicinal product, notification of any incident linked to its use and measures to be taken), the MAH shall include these conditions in its risk management system.
f.applicability: MAs granted in exceptional circumstances under conditions (Art. 6, § 1ersepties)

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (MA granted in exceptional circumstances)
rows.quote: ministre ou son délégué informe l'EMA des AMM qu'il a délivrées en les assortissant de conditions en application de l'alinéa précédent et le titulaire de l'AMM inclut ces conditions dans son système de gestion des risques.
rows.review_note: Review: actor and scope from the paragraph context (exceptional-circumstances MA). Double-check: quote proves the duty to include conditions in the RMS. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force; level follows the legislative present indicative, which states a binding duty in Belgian law (Mandatory).
rows.quote_en: ...minister or his delegate informs the EMA of the MAs he has issued subject to conditions pursuant to the preceding paragraph, and the holder of the MA includes these conditions in its risk management system.

f.title: Include conditional MA requirements (incl. PASS, stricter ADR reporting) in the RMS
f.statement: The minister or delegate may attach conditions to the marketing authorisation, including measures for safe use in the risk management system, obligations stricter than those of Article 12sexies on recording or notifying suspected adverse reactions, an adequate pharmacovigilance system, a post-authorisation safety study or a post-authorisation efficacy study; the MA states deadlines where applicable. The MAH shall include any such condition in its risk management system.
f.applicability: MAs granted with conditions under Art. 6, § 1erocties
f.processes: Risk management & minimisation; Epidemiology / safety studies

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder
rows.quote: b) le respect d'obligations plus rigoureuses que celles énoncées à l'article 12sexies en matière d'enregistrement ou de notification des effets indésirables suspectés; c) toute autre condition ou restriction destinée à garantir une utilisation sûre et efficace du médicament; d) l'existence d'un système de pharmacovigilance adéquat; e) la réalisation d'une étude de sécurité post-autorisation; f) la réalisation d'une étude d'efficacité post-autorisation lorsque certains aspects de l'efficacité du médicament soulèvent des questions qui ne peuvent recevoir de réponse qu'après la mise sur le marché du médicament. L'AMM précise, le cas échéant, dans quels délais ces conditions doivent être remplies. Le titulaire de l'AMM inclut toute condition visée à l'alinéa 1er dans son système de gestion des risques.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and scope; statement adds nothing. rows.quote_en: b) compliance with obligations stricter than those set out in Article 12sexies on the recording or notification of suspected adverse reactions; c) any other condition or restriction intended to ensure safe and effective use of the medicinal product; d) the existence of an adequate pharmacovigilance system; e) the conduct of a post-authorisation safety study; f) the conduct of a post-authorisation efficacy study where certain aspects of efficacy raise questions that can only be answered after marketing. The MA specifies, where applicable, the deadlines within which these conditions must be met. The holder of the MA includes any condition referred to in paragraph 1 in its risk management system.

f.title: Obtain approval of educational risk-minimisation materials before use
f.statement: Where conditions on safe use or other conditions require the marketing of the medicinal product to be accompanied by educational or informative materials, programmes or services, intended in particular for healthcare professionals or patients, these must be submitted to the minister or his delegate for approval, under the procedure set by the King, before they are implemented. This also applies to MAs granted by the European Commission with such conditions.
f.applicability: Belgium; national and centrally authorised MAs with such conditions

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder
rows.quote: Lorsque les conditions visée à l'alinéa 1er, a) et c), prévoient que la mise sur le marché du médicament doit être accompagnée de matériels, de programmes ou de services éducationnels ou informatifs destinés notamment aux professionnels des soins de santé ou aux patients, ces matériels, programmes ou services doivent être soumis à l'approbation du ministre ou de son délégué, selon la procédure fixée par le Roi, préalablement à leur mise en oeuvre. Cette disposition s'applique également aux AMM octroyées par la Commission européenne qui Page 12 de 47 Copyright Moniteur belge 18-06-2026 sont assorties de telles conditions.
rows.review_note: Review: actor (MAH as submitter) inferred from the procedure; the quote uses the passive 'doivent être soumis'. Double-check: duty and scope proven. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force; level follows the legislative present indicative, which states a binding duty in Belgian law (Mandatory).
rows.quote_en: Where the conditions referred to in paragraph 1, a) and c), provide that the placing on the market of the medicinal product must be accompanied by educational or informative materials, programmes or services intended in particular for healthcare professionals or patients, these materials, programmes or services must be submitted for the approval of the minister or his delegate, according to the procedure laid down by the King, prior to their implementation. This provision also applies to MAs granted by the European Commission which [page footer] are subject to such conditions.

f.title: Conduct imposed post-authorisation safety or efficacy studies and include them in the RMS
f.statement: After the MA is granted, the minister or delegate may, under the procedure set by the King, impose on the MAH an obligation to conduct a post-authorisation safety study (in particular where there are concerns about the risks of the authorised product) or a post-authorisation efficacy study (where understanding of the disease or clinical methodology indicates previous efficacy evaluations might need significant revision). The MAH shall include any such condition in its risk management system.
f.applicability: When imposed by the minister or delegate after MA grant
f.processes: Epidemiology / safety studies; Risk management & minimisation

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder
rows.quote: l'octroi de l'AMM, le ministre ou son délégué peut, selon la procédure fixée par le Roi, imposer au titulaire de l'AMM : a) l'obligation d'effectuer une étude de sécurité post-autorisation, notamment lorsqu'il existe des craintes quant aux risques de sécurité posés par le médicament autorisé; b) l'obligation d'effectuer une étude d'efficacité post-autorisation lorsque la compréhension de la maladie ou la méthodologie clinique indique que les évaluations d'efficacité antérieures pourraient devoir être revues de manière significative. Le titulaire de l'AMM inclut toute condition visée à l'alinéa 1er dans son système de gestion des risques.

rows.quote_en: ...the grant of the MA, the minister or his delegate may, according to the procedure laid down by the King, impose on the holder of the MA: a) the obligation to conduct a post-authorisation safety study, in particular where there are concerns about the safety risks posed by the authorised medicinal product; b) the obligation to conduct a post-authorisation efficacy study where understanding of the disease or the clinical methodology indicates that previous efficacy evaluations might have to be revised significantly. The holder of the MA includes any condition referred to in paragraph 1 in its risk management system.

f.title: Operate a pharmacovigilance system equivalent to the national system
f.statement: The MAH or registration holder shall implement a pharmacovigilance system equivalent to the AFMPS pharmacovigilance system to fulfil its pharmacovigilance tasks. It shall use this system to scientifically evaluate all information, consider options to prevent or minimise risks and take appropriate measures where necessary.

rows.actor: Holder of a marketing authorisation (AMM) or registration
rows.quote: titulaire d'une AMM ou d'un enregistrement met en oeuvre un système de pharmacovigilance équivalent au système de pharmacovigilance visé au § 1er, en vue de s'acquitter des tâches de pharmacovigilance qui lui incombent. Il utilise ce système de pharmacovigilance pour procéder à l'évaluation scientifique de toutes les informations, pour examiner les options permettant de prévenir les risques ou de les réduire au minimum et, au besoin, pour prendre des mesures appropriées.

rows.quote_en: ...holder of an MA or registration shall implement a pharmacovigilance system equivalent to the pharmacovigilance system referred to in § 1, in order to carry out the pharmacovigilance tasks incumbent on it. It shall use this pharmacovigilance system to carry out the scientific evaluation of all information, to examine options for preventing or minimising risks and, where necessary, to take appropriate measures.

f.title: Have a QPPV permanently available and, where applicable, a Belgian PV contact person
f.statement: Within its pharmacovigilance system the MAH or registration holder shall have permanently and continuously at its disposal an appropriately qualified person responsible for pharmacovigilance and, where applicable, a pharmacovigilance contact person at Belgian level attached to that qualified person, for each pharmacovigilance system master file. The King sets the conditions these persons must meet.

rows.quote_en: a) it has permanently and continuously at its disposal an appropriately qualified person responsible for pharmacovigilance and, where applicable, a pharmacovigilance contact person at Belgian level attached to that qualified person, for each pharmacovigilance system master file; the King lays down the conditions which the qualified person and the [page footer] contact person must meet to carry out their activities;

f.title: Maintain the PSMF and make it available on request
f.statement: The MAH or registration holder shall manage a pharmacovigilance system master file and make it available on request.

rows.actor: Holder of a marketing authorisation (AMM) or registration

rows.quote_en: b) it manages and makes available, on request, a pharmacovigilance system master file;

f.title: Operate a risk management system for each medicinal product
f.statement: The MAH or registration holder shall implement a risk management system for each medicinal product. By derogation, a holder of an MA or registration granted before 21 July 2012 is not required to implement a risk management system for each product.
f.exceptions: Not required for MAs or registrations granted before 21 July 2012 (Art. 12sexies, § 2, al. 3), unless imposed by the minister or delegate.

rows.actor: Holder of a marketing authorisation (AMM) or registration

Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force; level follows the legislative present indicative, which states a binding duty in Belgian law (Mandatory).
rows.quote_en: c) it implements a risk management system for each medicinal product;

f.title: Implement an RMS for pre-July-2012 products when the authority imposes it
f.statement: A holder of an MA or registration granted before 21 July 2012 is not required to implement a risk management system for each product; however, the minister or delegate may impose on the MAH the obligation to implement one if there are concerns about risks that could change the benefit-risk balance of an authorised product. The King sets the conditions and arrangements.
f.applicability: MAs or registrations granted before 21 July 2012

rows.actor: Holder of an MA or registration granted before 21 July 2012
rows.quote: Par dérogation à l'alinéa 2, c), le titulaire d'une AMM ou d'un enregistrement octroyé avant le 21 juillet 2012 n'est pas tenu de mettre en oeuvre un système de gestion des risques pour chaque médicament. Cependant, le ministre ou son délégué peut imposer au titulaire d'une AMM l'obligation de mettre en oeuvre un système de gestion des risques conformément à l'alinéa 2, c), s'il a des préoccupations quant aux risques pouvant modifier le rapport bénéfice/risque d'un médicament autorisé.

rows.quote_en: By way of derogation from paragraph 2, c), the holder of an MA or registration granted before 21 July 2012 is not required to implement a risk management system for each medicinal product. However, the minister or his delegate may impose on the holder of an MA the obligation to implement a risk management system in accordance with paragraph 2, c), if he has concerns about risks that may change the benefit/risk balance of an authorised medicinal product.

f.title: Monitor the outcome of risk minimisation measures
f.statement: The MAH or registration holder shall monitor the outcome of risk minimisation measures contained in the risk management plan or laid down as conditions of the MA under Article 6, § 1ersepties, § 1erocties or § 1ernonies.

rows.actor: Holder of a marketing authorisation (AMM) or registration

rows.quote_en: d) it monitors the outcome of risk minimisation measures provided for in the risk management plan or corresponding to conditions attached to the MA in accordance with Article 6, § 1ersepties, § 1erocties or § 1ernonies;

f.title: Update the RMS and monitor PV data for new or changed risks
f.statement: The MAH or registration holder shall keep the risk management system up to date and monitor pharmacovigilance data to detect new risks, changes to existing risks or changes to the benefit-risk balance of medicinal products.

rows.actor: Holder of a marketing authorisation (AMM) or registration
rows.quote: e) il tient à jour le système de gestion des risques et surveille les données de pharmacovigilance afin de repérer des risques nouveaux, des changements des risques existants ou une modification du rapport bénéfice/risque des médicaments;
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and scope; statement adds nothing. rows.quote_en: e) it keeps the risk management system up to date and monitors pharmacovigilance data in order to detect new risks, changes in existing risks or a change in the benefit/risk balance of medicinal products;

f.title: Record, report, evaluate and follow up suspected adverse reactions
f.statement: The MAH or registration holder shall record, report, evaluate and follow up the suspected adverse reactions of which it becomes aware.

rows.actor: Holder of a marketing authorisation (AMM) or registration
rows.quote: f) il enregistre, notifie, évalue et assure le suivi des effets indésirables suspectés dont il a connaissance.

rows.quote_en: f) it records, reports, evaluates and follows up the suspected adverse reactions of which it is aware.

f.title: Audit the PV system regularly, record findings in the PSMF and act on them
f.statement: The MAH or registration holder shall perform a periodic audit of its pharmacovigilance system, record the main findings in writing in the pharmacovigilance system master file and, based on the findings, ensure an appropriate corrective action plan is prepared and implemented. Once the corrective measures are fully implemented, the recorded notes may be removed.

rows.actor: Holder of a marketing authorisation (AMM) or registration
rows.quote: Le titulaire d'une AMM ou d'un enregistrement réalise un audit périodique de son système de pharmacovigilance. Il consigne par écrit les principaux résultats de cet audit dans le dossier permanent du système de pharmacovigilance et, en fonction de ces résultats, fait le nécessaire pour élaborer et mettre en oeuvre un plan d'action adéquat visant à remédier aux problèmes constatés. Une fois les mesures correctives intégralement mises en oeuvre, les mentions consignées peuvent être supprimées.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and scope; statement adds nothing. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force; level follows the legislative present indicative, which states a binding duty in Belgian law (Mandatory).
rows.quote_en: The holder of an MA or registration carries out a periodic audit of its pharmacovigilance system. It records in writing the main results of this audit in the pharmacovigilance system master file and, on the basis of these results, does what is necessary to draw up and implement an appropriate action plan to remedy the problems found. Once the corrective measures have been fully implemented, the recorded notes may be removed.

f.title: Inform authorities before or with any public PV announcement
f.statement: As soon as the MAH or registration holder intends to make a public announcement on pharmacovigilance concerns relating to the use of a medicinal product, and in any case before or at the same time as the announcement, it shall inform the minister or his delegate, the EMA and the European Commission.

rows.actor: Holder of a marketing authorisation (AMM) or registration
rows.deadline: Before or at the same time as the public announcement
rows.quote: Dès que le titulaire d'une AMM ou d'un enregistrement a l'intention de diffuser au grand public un avis relatif à des questions de pharmacovigilance concernant l'utilisation d'un médicament et, en tout état de cause, avant la diffusion d'un tel avis ou simultanément, il est tenu d'en informer le ministre ou son délégué, l'EMA et la Commission européenne.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: 'il est tenu de' = is required (Mandatory). Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force; level follows the legislative present indicative, which states a binding duty in Belgian law (Mandatory).
rows.quote_en: As soon as the holder of an MA or registration intends to make a public announcement on pharmacovigilance questions concerning the use of a medicinal product, and in any event before or at the same time as the announcement is made, it is required to inform the minister or his delegate, the EMA and the European Commission.

f.title: Present public safety information objectively and not misleadingly
f.statement: The MAH or registration holder shall also ensure that information to the public is presented objectively and is not misleading.

rows.actor: Holder of a marketing authorisation (AMM) or registration
rows.quote: Il veille également à ce que les informations destinées au public soient présentées de façon objective et ne soient pas trompeuses.

rows.quote_en: It shall also ensure that the information intended for the public is presented objectively and is not misleading.
